response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and distributed systems, and demonstrable low-latency/high-throughput work (Dlang microservices handling millions of requests/sec). However, the role centers on hands-on senior C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure development practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), message-broker-based C++ architectures, or Azure. His recent trajectory is TypeScript/Node full-stack and AI tooling, which points away from the core requirement rather than toward it.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience with distributed, low-latency, event-driven systems
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and public workshops
Proven ownership and full-stack breadth, plus open-source platform leadership
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience; core language requirement not met
No industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or IEC 62443/SDL security background
Recent work is TypeScript/Node web-focused, misaligned with the on-prem C++ platform role
